implementation_notes: Depend on the upstream artifact and use its types in the downstream model. Resist `UpstreamCustomerDto` mirrors; if the upstream is a legacy system, an adapter that speaks its API and returns its types is the conformity seam.
idiom_name: upstream artifact types used directly in the downstream
pitfalls: A `@Entity` mapped straight onto the upstream schema with no boundary at all
Upstream entities becoming the domain model of the downstream permanently
